_comment: AI & 4-point Homography calibration config for Nguyen Trai overpass camera (1920x1080 @ 30.02 FPS). Standard JSON uses _comment_* keys for inline documentation.
_comment_source: Video file path ('videos/real_1.mp4'), RTSP URL ('rtsp://...'), or '0' for webcam
_comment_yolo_weights: YOLOv5 weights ('yolov5n.pt' for fast real-time FPS, 'yolov5x.pt' for higher accuracy at lower FPS)
_comment_tracker_type: 'fast_sort' = lightweight Kalman+IoU tracker (~30 FPS, skips ReID CNN); 'deepsort' = OSNet ReID appearance matching
_comment_filter_roi_before_track: true = only send detections near/inside ROI (y2 >= roi_top_ratio - 0.05) to the tracker, cutting horizon overhead
_comment_reid_model: DeepSORT ReID checkpoint for keeping consistent vehicle track IDs across frames
_comment_deepsort_config: YAML config for DeepSORT matching thresholds (MAX_DIST, MAX_AGE, N_INIT)
_comment_imgsz: YOLO inference input size (640 for speed; 1280 detects distant vehicles better but reduces FPS)
_comment_conf_thres: Minimum confidence threshold to keep a detection (0.0 - 1.0)
_comment_iou_thres: NMS IoU threshold to suppress overlapping bounding boxes (0.0 - 1.0)
_comment_classes: COCO class IDs to detect: 2 = car, 3 = motorcycle, 5 = bus, 7 = truck
_comment_loop_video: true = loop video playback at EOF; false = stop when video ends
_comment_realtime_pace: true = match original video FPS; false = run as fast as GPU allows

speed_estimation._comment_calibration_mode: 'homography' = 4-point perspective road mapping (recommended); 'linear' = fixed m/px scale
speed_estimation._comment_roi_top_ratio: Top boundary of valid measurement ROI as fraction of frame height (0.37 ~ y=400px on 1080p, excluding high-distortion far field)
speed_estimation._comment_roi_bottom_ratio: Bottom boundary of valid measurement ROI as fraction of frame height (0.96 ~ y=1037px on 1080p)
speed_estimation._comment_counting_line_y_ratio: Virtual line for vehicle flow counting (fraction of frame height, between roi_top_ratio and roi_bottom_ratio)
speed_estimation._comment_sliding_window_frames: Sliding window length in frames for speed estimation (15 frames ~ 0.5s at 30 FPS to smooth out jitter)
speed_estimation._comment_min_history_frames: Minimum frames inside ROI before reporting speed (prevents initial spawn spikes)
speed_estimation._comment_min_displacement_px: Minimum pixel movement across the sliding window; below this is treated as stationary (0 km/h)
speed_estimation._comment_min_time_delta_s: Minimum elapsed seconds required for valid speed calculation (prevents division-by-zero spikes)
speed_estimation._comment_distance_meters: Fallback real-world span in meters when calibration_mode = 'linear' and calibration_scale_m_per_px is null
speed_estimation._comment_calibration_scale_m_per_px: Fixed meters-per-pixel scale for 'linear' mode (null auto-computes from distance_meters)
speed_estimation._comment_speed_limit_kmh: Posted road speed limit (km/h) displayed in KPIs and violation alerts
speed_estimation._comment_warn_speed_kmh: Speed threshold (km/h) that turns the bounding box yellow
speed_estimation._comment_alert_speed_kmh: Speed threshold (km/h) that turns the bounding box red and logs a Live Violation alert
speed_estimation._comment_smoothing_alpha: EMA smoothing factor (0.01 - 1.0): lower = smoother readout; 1.0 = raw sliding-window value
speed_estimation._comment_max_speed_kmh: Upper plausibility cap (km/h) to reject outliers from ID switches or bbox jumps
speed_estimation._comment_stale_ttl_frames: Frames to retain a track_id state after disappearance before cleanup

homography._comment_src_norm_points: 4 normalized image anchor points [x/W, y/H] ordered [P1 top-left, P2 top-right, P3 bottom-right, P4 bottom-left] aligned to road markings L1 & L3
homography._comment_dst_meter_points: Corresponding real-world road coordinates in meters [X, Y]: 2 lanes wide = 7.0m, length (dash 2 + gap + dash 1) = 10.0m
